HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

2. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

6. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

9. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
